title: Hearally transcript, version 1
description: Written by the Parakeet transcription job (transcriber/) to a signed S3 link under transcripts/<account>/<event_id>.json, read once by the backend (backend/src/hearally/transcription.py), then deleted. Raw text of what was said: never logged, never kept; the prefix also expires after a day. Times are seconds from the start of the recording. Confidence is Parakeet's word confidence, 0 to 1, or null when the decoder did not report it.

id.description: The recording's event id: the SHA-256 of its audio.

confidence_available.description: True only when every word carries a confidence. When false, the backend treats unmeasured segments as confidence 0, so they can never cause a text on their own.

confidence.description: Mean word confidence in the segment.

words.description: Word timings, which redaction uses to bleep numbers out of the audio.
